name: Jamlek
title: Simeonite tribal chieftain
summary: Jamlek was one of the leaders in the tribe of Simeon mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He was among the Simeonite chieftains who led an expansion into the Gedor area to find pasture for their livestock. His name appears in the genealogies as part of the tribe's leadership during the period of the divided kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Simeon's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jamlek is listed as one of the chieftains in the tribe of Simeon in the detailed genealogical record of 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Simeonite leadership
keyEvents.description: Jamlek belonged to a group of named men who were leaders in their clans, and these families had grown large and numerous.

keyEvents.title: Search for pasture
keyEvents.description: During the reign of Judah's king Hezekiah, Jamlek and the other Simeonite leaders went out to find grazing land for their livestock, as they needed new land for their flocks.

keyEvents.title: Expansion into the Gedor valley
keyEvents.description: The chieftains, including Jamlek, found lush and good grazing lands in the Gedor valley, a spacious, quiet, and peaceful land that had previously been inhabited by Hamites.

keyEvents.title: Conquest of new territory
keyEvents.description: The Simeonite leaders defeated the original inhabitants and settled in their place, because there was pasture for their livestock there.
